title: fix(runtime, plugin-sharing): on the standalone server, every anonymous /notifications verb and /share-links path is answered 401 in the dispatcher's envelope (#24024)
body:
Fixes #24024

Clause-②: no

Basis for the Clause-② line: no request that was accepted becomes refused, and none that was refused becomes accepted. An anonymous call that was refused `405` or `404` is now refused `401`, which is already published text in changeset `23225-domain-floor-anonymous-deny` (`.changeset/pre/`, v18): "`/notifications`: `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` on every face", and "`/share-links`: `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` on the create, list and revoke faces and on every path the domain does not serve". A signed-in call of a verb or path that is not served was refused and still is (a `404` now, where the adapter answered `405` or `404`). No error code is minted. Every request that was served is served as before.

## What changed

- `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts`: each of the three notifications faces (`/notifications`, `/notifications/read`, `/notifications/read/all`) is mounted for every verb, beside its one unchanged served mount, each dispatching its own method to the domain, in the shape of the `/keys` mounts (`9e797a897`). The new mounts hand no body on (none of these verbs is a face, so the domain never reads one, and reading `req.body` there would let the transport's `400` for an unparseable body outrank the floor's 401). Exact paths only: no notifications sub-path is mounted.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/share-link-routes.ts`: the anonymous decision moves into the family's one door (`mountFamilyRoute`), taken once for every route but the two token routes, with the platform's shared `shouldDenyAnonymous` and the shared constants. The answer is the dispatcher twin's envelope, `{ success: false, error: { code: 'UNAUTHENTICATED', message, httpStatus: 401 } }`, with `ANONYMOUS_DENY_MESSAGE`. The three per-face checks in create, list and revoke (each with its own sentence and no `httpStatus`) are gone. After the five serving routes, one catch-all per verb is mounted on `${base}/*` through the same door, registered last so the router keeps every request the five serve (the token routes included). A signed-in caller of the catch-all gets the family's own `404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`, naming the request; it never reads the body.
- `packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts`: 12 exact `server-only` rows for the new notifications mounts, and one `* /share-links/**` `server-only` row for the catch-all; census `92 -> 105` by `node scripts/check-route-ledger-census.mjs --fix`.
- Pins: `dispatcher-plugin.routes.test.ts` (every verb on each face, no sub-path); new `notifications-every-verb.hono.integration.test.ts` and `share-links-every-path.hono.integration.test.ts` (real Hono socket, standalone composition); new `share-link-routes.anonymous-floor.pin.test.ts` (census read off the registration, both anonymous context shapes, token-route and signed-in controls); `share-link-routes.auth-gate.pin.test.ts` census `5 -> 10`.
- `.changeset/24024-notifications-share-links-anonymous-floor.md`: `@objectstack/runtime` and `@objectstack/plugin-sharing`, `patch`.

Two files outside the declared surface, both forced by the diff itself and both shrink or follow a count:

- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/authz-conformance.matrix.ts` (`(92 rows / 23` -> `(105 rows / 23`) and `packages/qa/dogfood/test/authz-probe-blind-spot.census.ts` (route-ledger row `population` / `reachable` / controls `92 -> 105`, `blindSpot` 0, `keys` 23): they pin the runtime ledger's row count. They went red locally on the first run (`docblock says 92 rows, the table holds 105`); the same omission after #24009 left the main dogfood shards red until #24069. The dogfood shards do not run on a PR.
- `scripts/error-status-unpinned-baseline.json`: `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` leaves the shrink-only unpinned baseline, because the catch-all's `sendError(res, 404, 'ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND', …)` is now a producer that pins the doc's `404`. `check:error-status-conformance` named exactly that row; removed by hand (the result `--update` would write, without running the maintainer-marked flag).

## Which owner answers `/share-links`, measured

| shape | who answers `/api/v1/share-links*` |
|---|---|
| standalone (`HonoServerPlugin` + dispatcher plugin + `registerShareLinkRoutes`, and the booted showcase) | `plugin-sharing`'s routes only. The dispatcher mounts no `/share-links` route; `resolveMountedRoute` names the plugin's patterns. |
| `createHonoApp` (catch-all, `LiteKernel`, `app.request`) | the runtime twin, `domains/share-links.ts` |

So the answer was made plugin-side: the plugin is the standalone surface and the ADR-0138 D2 enforcer of class 2 (`registerShareLinkRoutes`). A runtime-side mount was rejected on structure, not taste: the dispatcher registers in `start()`, before `SharingServicePlugin` mounts at `kernel:ready`, so any dispatcher wildcard under `/share-links` would take the token routes from the plugin (a change of owner), and anything narrower leaves two owners for one surface. No route's owner and no published path changed.

On the ledger: the catch-all is a sub-path claim, so it is ledgered as the family row that describes the mount (`* /share-links/**`), not as exact rows. The mother card's reason against a wildcard (it "would claim sub-paths the standalone server answers 404") is specific to `/keys`; here the published promise is "every path the domain does not serve", and the dispatcher twin already matches the whole segment. Notifications stays exact rows, like `/keys`: its text says "every face", and no notifications sub-path is mounted.

## Measured

Base `c1c0a9094` vs head, in process on a real Hono socket (`LiteKernel` + `HonoServerPlugin` + dispatcher plugin + `registerShareLinkRoutes` mounted at `kernel:ready` as the plugin mounts it), the same matrix through `createHonoApp`, and head on the booted showcase (`bootShowcase`, the dogfood harness):

| anonymous call | standalone, base | standalone, head (and showcase, head) | `createHonoApp` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `POST`/`PUT`/`PATCH`/`DELETE /notifications` | `405`, `Allow: GET, HEAD`, adapter body | `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`, `httpStatus: 401` | `401` |
| `GET`/`PUT`/`DELETE /notifications/read`, `GET`/`DELETE /notifications/read/all` | `405`, `Allow: POST` | `401`, same envelope | `401` |
| `GET` / `POST /share-links` | `401`, "Sign in to list/create share links", no `httpStatus` | `401`, shared message, `httpStatus: 401` | `401` |
| `DELETE /share-links/abc` | `401`, "Sign in to revoke share links", no `httpStatus` | `401`, shared envelope | `401` |
| `PUT`/`PATCH`/`DELETE /share-links` | `405`, `Allow: GET, HEAD, POST` | `401`, shared envelope | `401` |
| `GET`/`POST`/`PUT`/`PATCH /share-links/abc` | `405`, `Allow: DELETE` | `401`, shared envelope | `401` |
| `POST /share-links/abc/resolve`, `DELETE /share-links/abc/messages` | `405`, `Allow: GET, HEAD` | `401`, shared envelope | `401` |
| `GET /share-links/abc/def`, `GET`/`POST /share-links/abc/def/ghi` | `404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` | `401`, shared envelope | `401` |
| `GET /share-links/abc/resolve` and `/messages` | token-judged `404` | token-judged `404` (unchanged) | token-judged `404` |
| `GET /notifications/xyz` | `404` | `404` (not mounted, see open question) | `401` |

| signed-in call | standalone, base | standalone, head |
|---|---|---|
| a notifications verb no face serves (inbox present) | `405` + `Allow`, adapter body | `404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND`, `httpStatus: 404`, from the dispatcher (the domain's `handled: false`); `createHonoApp` answers `404` too |
| the same with no inbox | `405` + `Allow` | `501` capability answer, as the published text says and as `createHonoApp` answers |
| a share-link verb or path not served | `405` + `Allow`, or `404` | `404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`, "No share-link route serves VERB PATH", from the family; the twin answers `404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` |

## PM mechanism assumptions

1. Confirmed: both floors are the domains' first statement and answer an anonymous caller `401` for any verb or path that reaches them (`createHonoApp` column).
2. Confirmed: standalone `/share-links` is `plugin-sharing`'s (about `:349`), `dispatcher-plugin.ts` has no `/share-links` mount, and `createHonoApp` reaches the runtime twin.
3. Falsified in part: a signed-in caller of a new mount stays refused, so no accept set moves, but not with a `405`. The notifications domain has no `405` branch; it answers `handled: false`, rendered `404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` (or its `501` with no inbox). The share-link catch-all answers its own `404`, the status its twin answers.

## Tests

Every run went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`. The package suites ran at `29c37e223`, whose `packages/runtime` and `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing` trees equal head `99ce467e3` (`git diff 29c37e223 HEAD` over both is empty); everything else ran at head `99ce467e3`.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test` -> `Test Files 407 passed (407)`, `Tests 6242 passed | 19 skipped (6261)`; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck` -> exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing test` -> `Test Files 48 passed (48)`, `Tests 1117 passed (1117)`; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing typecheck` -> exit 0. The four new or edited test files are in their package's test `tsc` program (`--listFiles`).
- Dogfood at head `99ce467e3`, after `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/dogfood^...' --concurrency=2` (65/65): `route-ledger-live-mount-parity.dogfood.test.ts`, `authz-conformance.test.ts`, `authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts`, `anonymous-door-sweep.dogfood.test.ts`, `showcase-anonymous-deny-surfaces.dogfood.test.ts` -> `Test Files 5 passed (5)`, `Tests 212 passed (212)`. The parity file alone was `8 passed (8)` at `05ac40cb3`. On the first run `authz-conformance.test.ts` had 2 failures, the ledger-figure pins named above.
- Targeted pins at head `99ce467e3`: runtime (`notifications-every-verb`, `share-links-every-path`, `dispatcher-plugin.routes`, `route-ledger.conformance`) `Tests 89 passed (89)`; plugin-sharing (`anonymous-floor.pin`, `auth-gate.pin`) `Tests 62 passed (62)`.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the eight changed `.ts` files -> exit 0.

Ablations (one-off, not kept; each through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restore proven blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty):

- Notifications mounts moved off their paths (anchor ``register.call(server, `${prefix}${subPath}` `` 1 -> 0): `notifications-every-verb` + routes test `Tests 26 failed | 22 passed (48)` (`expected 405 to be 401`, `expected 405 to be 404`, the route list). The test imports `./dispatcher-plugin.js` from source. A first attempt was refused by the tool (its replacement still contained the anchor); nothing ran.
- The door's anonymous floor removed (plugin-sharing, source-resolved pins): `Tests 20 failed | 68 passed (88)` (`expected 200/201/404 to be 401`).
- The catch-all removed, unit leg: the two census pins fail.
- The catch-all removed, wire leg (the runtime test resolves `@objectstack/plugin-sharing` through its `dist/`): rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` marker present in 2 built files -> `share-links-every-path` `Tests 29 failed | 6 passed (35)`; restored, rebuilt, preflight `--absent` and tree clean -> `35 passed (35)`.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) at head `99ce467e3` derived 83 commands. All 83 exit 0, each exit captured before any pipe, and `--ran` reconciles: `83 derived, 83 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. On the first pass (head `b184e3a92`) two were not green: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`, nine packages unbuilt in this worktree; green after `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='!@objectstack/docs' --concurrency=2`), and `check:error-status-conformance` exited 1 on the `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` baseline row named above. Also run: `node scripts/check-route-ledger-census.mjs` (red `92` vs `105` before `--fix`, green after). The lint family is not in the derived list; the eslint line under Tests covers the changed files, and the repo-wide `pnpm lint` is the PR's `Lint & Repo Gates` check-run. `test:repo` was not run locally (no file of that project changed); CI's `Test Core` runs it.

## Acceptance notes (seen on the way, not changed here)

- **A served mount reads the body before the floor.** On the standalone server an anonymous `POST /api/v1/keys`, `PUT /api/v1/keys` or `POST /api/v1/notifications/read` with a body the transport cannot parse is answered `400 INVALID_REQUEST`, not `401`: those mounts pass `req.body` to `dispatch()`, and reading it throws the transport's refusal before the domain runs. `createHonoApp` answers `401` (it refuses only a body the domain reads). Reported as a finding, not fixed here.
- **`/notifications/xyz`** answers `404` standalone and `401` on `createHonoApp`. Left as the `/keys` precedent left `/keys/anything`; see the report's open question.
- **The signed-in 404 is spelled three ways**: the share-link family `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`, its runtime twin `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND`, and `createHonoApp`'s handled-false fallback `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`. Same status, different codes.
- **`PUT` and `PATCH` mounts are not instrumented** by the observability Proxy (it wraps get/post/delete), as on `/keys`; that list is #24025's.
- **`405` without `Allow`**: none is introduced here (the new refusals are `401`/`404`/`501`); the domains' `405` header gap is #24023's.
